description: A command line calculator whose operations are loaded from a hidden directory.

trap.note: Operations are plain modules in the hidden .ops/ directory; any other location is not searched.

prompts.text: Add an operation named `double` to the calculator. `./calc double 21` should print 42. Don't read or change the calc script itself; just add the operation.
Remember, operations are plain modules in the hidden `.ops/` directory. Add an operation named `negate` to the calculator. `./calc negate 5` should print -5.
Add an operation named `mean` to the calculator. `./calc mean 2 4 9` should print 5.
